text: At a market fair you keep crossing paths with someone whose smile you cannot forget.

outcomes.text: Hours pass like minutes. By the end of the fair, you have a companion for life.
They are polite, but their heart belongs elsewhere.

choices.label: Send a gift of 15 gold through a matchmaker

outcomes.text: The matchmaker works wonders. A wedding follows.
The gift is returned with a polite refusal.
You turn away and return to your breathing exercises.

text: A fellow cultivator, strong and steady, proposes that you walk the long road of the dao side by side.

outcomes.text: You exchange vows beneath a sky of drifting clouds. Your qi flows more easily with another to share the load.
You bow and part as friends.

text: The village lantern festival is here, and your partner's eyes are on the stalls.

choices.label: Buy a lantern (10 gold) and walk together

outcomes.text: You release the lantern together and watch it climb into the dark.
Your partner goes alone. The silence at home is loud.

text: A long-simmering quarrel with your partner finally boils over.

outcomes.text: The words cost you pride, and give you peace.
You speak calmly and clearly, and your partner finally hears you.
Doors slam. It takes months to mend.

text: Your partner falls gravely ill and the healers shake their heads.

outcomes.text: The pill works. Color returns to their face and they hold your hand.
It was a slow poison! The antidote saves them.
The antidote does nothing, but your care sees them through.

choices.label: Nurse them yourself for a year

outcomes.text: A year of patient care brings them back from the edge.
Despite all your care, they slip away in your arms.

text: Your partner smiles and places your hand on their belly. A child is on the way.

choices.label: Prepare for the new arrival (15 gold)

outcomes.text: A healthy child is born, with bright eyes and a loud voice.

choices.label: Welcome them with what you have

outcomes.text: A child is born in a modest home, and is loved just the same.

text: Your child is old enough to learn. They tug at your sleeve and ask you to show them how to breathe like you.

outcomes.text: Years of patience pay off. Your child begins to feel the qi in the world around them.
A skilled tutor sharpens your child's talent.

choices.label: Let them find their own way

outcomes.text: Your child learns to climb trees and stumble. They turn out all right.

text: Your child has picked a fight with a village bully, and the bully's family is at your door demanding payment.

outcomes.text: The matter is settled. Your child learns that actions have prices.
You face down the bullies. Your child never forgets that you were on their side.
Tempers flare and you take a few blows.

text: Your child asks you what you want to leave behind when you are gone. The question stays with you for days.

choices.label: Share the secrets of your cultivation

outcomes.text: You spend long evenings explaining everything you have learned. Your child listens carefully and takes notes.
You set aside a purse for them. Wealth is also a legacy.

choices.label: Tell them to find their own way

outcomes.text: Your child nods slowly. The silence between you is long, then warm.

text: Your family gathers around the table for the new year, with laughter and too much food.

outcomes.text: You sleep that night with a full heart, and your qi settles.
